pairs.question: Q1
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Book or origin is not the selected 範 model/frame sense.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The character and standalone noun have a model-to-follow sense, so 範's model is defensible for 本.
pairs.limitations: The model sense is independently attested; it is not inferred from whole-word 手本 or asserted for every use of 本.

pairs.question: Q2
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: An image or statue is a representation, not necessarily a model to follow; the English model label can also name a representation.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: For an image or made likeness, English model can describe a representation rather than the normative standard sense.
pairs.independentSources: 像 lines 7-9, 13-17; JMdict 1403110, 1956840; KANJIDIC2 像
pairs.limitations: Conservative English-label ambiguity, not an assertion that all images are exemplary standards; optical and mathematical senses remain distinct.

pairs.question: Q3
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: 囲's displayed verbs describe surrounding or enclosing; 範's attested delimited frame is what is bounded, not an attested act of surrounding.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: A model or standard to follow is not established by 囲's surrounding or surrounding-area senses.
pairs.independentSources: 囲 lines 7-8; JMdict 1235960, 1481890, 1438050; KANJIDIC2 囲; 範 source lines 19-20
pairs.limitations: 囲 can name enclosure and abstract surroundings, not only physical fencing; the whole word 範囲 does not prove that 囲 means a model or 範 an enclosing action. This is bounded, not proof of all unseen senses.

pairs.question: Q4
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: 方 includes direction and method, and also a region and category; 範's sourced frame/category association does not establish a direction or method.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: 方's method, field, side and category senses are not sourced as a model to follow or standard.
pairs.limitations: 方 as さま is marked rare in JMdict 1545790; person/suffix and archaic uses retain their restrictions. A prescribed method is not itself a standard, and 範疇 is a whole word.

pairs.question: Q5
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Degree/extent is related to dimensions but is not automatically the 範 normative sense; occurrence is separate.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The character entry independently gives a standard or exemplar branch, making 範's model/standard label defensible for 度.
pairs.limitations: A ruler, scale marks, degree and occurrence are distinct from the character's model branch; 2252690 marks the spelling search-only and an old reading obsolete.

pairs.question: Q6
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: English measure can name a measurement; the shared のり entry includes measurement across, so the displayed label is conservatively ambiguous.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: 計 has measuring and a measuring-device branch, but neither establishes that a device is a normative model; the reverse label is not independently established.
pairs.independentSources: 計 lines 7-14; JMdict 1252050, 1600650, 1438050; 範 source lines 11-15; KANJIDIC2 計
pairs.limitations: A measuring instrument, the measuring action and the result/standard length are different; no claim that 範 is a device or はかる verb. Shared spellings of はかる do not imply unrestricted substitution.

pairs.question: Q7
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: English measure or gauge can name a measurement; のり includes a transverse measurement, so this is conservatively protected.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The sourced 測 branches are measuring and inference, not a normative exemplar; no reverse equivalence is asserted.
pairs.independentSources: 測 lines 7-8; JMdict 1600650, 1438050; 範 source lines 11-15; KANJIDIC2 測
pairs.limitations: Measurement result and action are distinct, as is estimation; the shared のり entry does not establish ordinary 範 spelling for every measurement.

pairs.question: Q8
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: A transverse dimension can be expressed as an amount of length, while 量 includes measurable magnitude; this is a conservative label guard.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: A measured amount or capacity is not thereby a normative standard or model.
pairs.independentSources: 量 lines 14-18, 21-25; JMdict 1554640, 1600650, 1438050; 範 source lines 11-15; KANJIDIC2 量
pairs.limitations: A capacity device is not the measured result or a standard length; philosophical uses remain separate. The dictionary-only spelling 範 is not asserted equally natural for every のり sense.

pairs.question: Q9
pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: The human-conduct sense of のり concerns a way of right conduct; 理's displayed reasons and logic concern explanatory order or inference, not an attested translation of that conduct sense.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: 理 can be a general principle or natural law, but its supplied senses do not establish a model to imitate or a normative standard.
pairs.independentSources: 理 lines 7-8, 16-30; JMdict 1957060, 2412900, 1454260, 1438050; 範 source lines 7-10; KANJIDIC2 理
pairs.limitations: Do not erase the genuine human-conduct 道理 association: a principle may guide conduct without the English labels becoming interchangeable. Buddhist and neo-Confucian senses remain qualified; this is not an exhaustive negative.
